children: New Jersey Resources' board has raised the natural-gas provider's quarterly dividend by 5.3%, to 50 cents from 47.5 cents.
The new payout, equal to $2.00 a year, represents an annual yield of about 3.77% based on Thursday's trading price of $53.11, up from 3.58%.
The Wall, N.J., company said the increased dividend is payable Oct. 1 to shareholders of record as of Sept. 24.
